stories.title: NFL Week 9 Power Rankings: Updated 1-32 poll, plus the best in-season trade acquisitions ever
stories.summary: How does every NFL team stack up heading into Week 9? We made our 1-32 list and picked the best trade deadline acquisitions of all time.

stories.title: Let's kick off Week 9: Why Solak thinks the Buccaneers, Steelers will win their divisions
stories.summary: Plus, takes on why RBs could dominate the trade deadline and teams that should ask about Justin Herbert.

stories.title: Sources: Liberty head coach DeMarco out after one year at the helm
stories.summary: The Liberty will not retain head coach Chris DeMarco after one year at the helm, sources told ESPN. The Liberty were eliminated in the semifinals of the playoffs.

stories.title: Police open investigation into Tenerife player's death after on-field collision
stories.summary: Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel died at age 30 after an on-field collision in a Spanish LaLiga 2 match on Monday, his club announced.

stories.title: Top-25 senior Jordan becomes Pitino's highest-ranked recruit at St. John's
stories.summary: Top-25 senior Malachi Jordan has committed to St. John's, he told ESPN, giving Rick Pitino his highest-ranked recruit since taking over the Red Storm.
